rule_matrix.rule: Read-only census
rule_matrix.detail: Rewriting every input with identical bytes passes the generated suite; independent stat records changed mtime. No test asserts absence of writes.

rule_matrix.rule: Exact byte size; bytes never decoded
rule_matrix.detail: Exact ordinary-file size is enforced. UTF-8 decode/encode mutation passes; independent ff000a800d input crashes with UnicodeDecodeError rather than reporting five bytes and two terminators.

rule_matrix.rule: Terminator formula, trailing LF, unterminated line, lone CR, LF+CR and terminators-only
rule_matrix.detail: All five named wrong formulas fail value assertions while answering. Primary LF fixture ends with LF; a missing-terminator overcount is also rejected. This is a bounded mutation result, not exhaustive proof over byte strings.

rule_matrix.rule: SHA256 of exact input bytes
rule_matrix.detail: Fake digest rejected; unmodified binary-input digest agrees with independently computed exact-byte SHA256. Binary-decode survivor is separately N1.

rule_matrix.rule: Missing/unreadable: exit 2, ERR_INPUT stderr, empty stdout
rule_matrix.detail: Baseline meets contract; generated tests require only nonzero and ERR_INPUT for missing input. Exit 7 and unexpected stdout both survive; directory unreadability is not tested.

rule_matrix.rule: Column-zero 1-6 hashes, mandatory space/tab, then text
rule_matrix.detail: Tab rejection survives. Unisolated optional-separator mutation is rejected because it also accepts level 7; adding (?!#) isolates mandatory-separator defect and survives. Thus that first red does not establish the separator rule. Empty-text boundary remains ambiguous; see G07.

rule_matrix.rule: Ignore 7+ hashes without error
rule_matrix.detail: Both accepting seven hashes and rejecting six are detected. Fixture contains levels 1-7 today, but its continued presence is not precondition-guarded (P01).

rule_matrix.rule: Strip whitespace-prefixed closing hashes; preserve bare content hash
attempts: maker: trailing hash stripped without sequence
rule_matrix.detail: Both ASCII-space closing/hash counterexamples are rejected; direct tab closing sequence is correctly removed. Scope says whitespace without defining its Unicode domain; NBSP is not removed (G07).

rule_matrix.rule: Keep text exactly, nonASCII and NFD; no Unicode normalization
rule_matrix.detail: NonASCII drop and NFC composition are detected. Exact review6 NFKD mutation STILL PASSES, changing composed café to cafe+combining acute on an independent input. Internal-space collapse also survives. Baseline strips trailing content spaces despite exact-text wording (G01).

rule_matrix.rule: One-based file line number
rule_matrix.detail: Offset mutation is rejected by exact heading list assertions, including blank/body lines.

rule_matrix.rule: Missing/undecodable: exit 2 and ERR_INPUT stderr
rule_matrix.detail: Baseline correct; dropping UnicodeError handler and replacing exit 2 with exit 7 both pass tests. Undecodable input is absent from generated suite.

rule_matrix.rule: JSON path queue order; max-steps N bounds; default 2
rule_matrix.detail: Order reversal, ignoring explicit limit, and default 1 rejected. Baseline forbids N=3 despite scope not stating a 1-or-2 domain; test_agent.py:29 requires rejection and fails the mutation which permits N=3 and correctly reviews all three files. Scope must specify its allowed N domain, not inherit test intent.

rule_matrix.rule: Per-entry path, exact bytes, exact digest
rule_matrix.detail: Existing default and one-step assertions check exact paths, sizes and digests. All corresponding maker mutations are detected.

rule_matrix.rule: Steps number reviewed; remaining queue length minus steps
rule_matrix.detail: All named numeric corruptions rejected on the exercised default/limited cases; empty fields also asserted exactly.

rule_matrix.rule: BUDGET vs QUEUE_EXHAUSTED, including empty queue
rule_matrix.detail: Empty-queue and truncated-queue cases guarded; nonempty exhausted queue missing. Returning BUDGET for every nonempty queue passes and is wrong on a one-file queue with default budget two. Equality at budget/queue length also lacks an explicit precedence sentence.

rule_matrix.rule: Unreadable entry or nonarray queue exits 2, no skipping
rule_matrix.detail: All three wrong implementations pass suite. {} becomes successful empty review under disabled validation; nonexistent entry is silently skipped; input errors may exit 7 undetected. Baseline handles these correctly.

rule_matrix.rule: Fence/code-block parsing excluded, but fence headings explicitly still reported
rule_matrix.detail: Baseline reports fenced heading; a fence-suppressing mutation passes. Full Markdown context parsing can legitimately be excluded, but the positive still-reported sentence conflicts with the blanket no-test-expectation framing. Do not silently use the exclusion to erase the positive statement.

rule_matrix.rule: Setext excluded
rule_matrix.detail: Direct unmodified probe ignores Setext. No requirement to implement full Markdown is imposed; no defect scored for absent Setext support.

rule_matrix.rule: BOM excluded, but counted and not stripped before parsing
rule_matrix.detail: Baseline does not strip BOM; a stripping mutation passes. Positive no-stripping promise and no-test-expectation framing should be reconciled; counted bytes already follows universal N1.

rule_matrix.rule: Symlinks/devices/changing files; concurrency/retry/caching/nonlocal I/O excluded
rule_matrix.detail: No tests or unsupported features demanded for these explicit exclusions. They do not cover invalid UTF8 census, tabs, NFKD, local queue errors, or crash classification. Bytecode-cache correctness of the TEST INSTRUMENT is not excused by application caching exclusion.

rule_matrix.rule: Each rule fixture/precondition; build RED/GREEN/location; every invocation probed; only noncrash assertion counts; exit reflects flags
rule_matrix.detail: Recorded REDs are output assertions, current recorded source/installed digests match and three installed tests pass; full builder not re-executed under two-output write limit. Level-six fixture removal passes. Harness probes 1/1/2 invocations versus tests 8/3/4 (including intended errors); even successful empty queue is omitted. Limited hard exits now honestly fail harness, but empty-queue hard exits are falsely caught and actual harness main exits 0 with every flag true.

P01 level-six fixture removed and suite passes; P02/P03 wrong fixture shape not rejected by their nominal preconditions. P04-P08 guarded.
